cohort: 70 mothers with newborns with a fifth-minute Apgar score less than 7 (cases) and 140 mothers with newborns with a fifth-minute Apgar score greater than or equal to 7 (controls) who delivered by Cesarean section at a hospital in Ethiopia
finding: A fifth-minute low Apgar score was significantly associated with newborns delivered through emergency Cesarean section, low birth weight, rural residence, and delivered from mothers who had undergone Cesarean section under general anesthesia.
